title: Kare First Love
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Karin Karino, a timid 16-year-old high-school girl, is asked out by Kiriya, a popular boy from a nearby boys' school. Her classmate Yuka, who likes Kiriya too, turns openly hostile and tries to sabotage the relationship. The series follows the couple's first romance through high school.
life_message: A good life means growing out of shyness and trusting a sincere first love despite others' jealousy.
